title: Cientista de Dados
description:
REQUISITOS MANDATÓRIOS

EXPERIÊNCIA

  • Experiência com análise e modelagem de dados aplicadas à indústria de óleo e gás Atuação prévia em empresas do setor energético ou projetos envolvendo engenharia de dados e analytics Vivência em projetos de otimização operacional, manutenção preditiva e monitoramento de ativos;
  • Habilidade com Linguagens de Programação: Python, R, SQL Machine Learning & Estatística: Modelagem preditiva, séries temporais, aprendizado de máquina Banco de Dados: PostgreSQL, SQL Server, NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra) Processamento;
  • Conhecimento com Engenharia de Dados: ETL, Apache Spark, Databricks;
  • Habilidade com Power BI
  • Habilidade com Cloud Computing: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud (foco na infraestrutura utilizada pela Petrobras) e Big Data: Hadoop, Kafka;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de DevOps e MLOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD;
  • Capacidade analítica e visão estratégica para transformar dados em insights acionáveis Comunicação clara para interagir com equipes multidisciplinares (engenharia, TI, negócios) Proatividade na resoluço de problemas operacionais e suporte à tomada de decisão Adaptação a ambientes regulados e metodologias ágeis.

ESCOLARIDADE

  • Graduação: Superior em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática, Física, ou áreas correlatas. 
  • Pós-graduação: Pós-graduação ou MBA em Ciência de Dados, Inteligência Artificial ou Big Data (desejável).
  • Certificação: Ao menos uma das certificações a seguir (Certificação PMI-ACP, CBPP, BPM ou Lean 6-Sigma (Black Belt) ou Certificação PMP ou PMI-ACP, Professional Scrum Master (PSM), Team Kanban Practitioner (TKP), Lean 6-Sigma (Black Belt) ou Ceritificação Oficial SAFe

  • Certificações (Desejáveis)

    Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Scientist Associate AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty Google Professional Data Engineer Certificações em Big Data, Machine Learning e Analytics Visualização de Dados: Tableau, Grafana

ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Atuar nos subeixos de conformidade, desenvolvimento de habilidades e competências, negócios, processos, projetos, cadeia de suprimentos e transformação digital, realizando a coordenação técnica, análises críticas, apoio estratégico, otimizações, estudos técnicos, condução de trabalhos técnicos especializados, desenvolvimento de soluções, melhoria dos processos e atividades, consultorias, identificação de riscos e oportunidades. 

REQUISITOS DESEJÁVEIS

  • Certificações em Microsoft Power Platform, Azure Solutions Architect e Automation Anywhere;
  • Experiência em Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning para análise avançada de dados;
  • Soft Skills: Habilidade para interpretar e explorar dados de forma estratégica;
  • Boa comunicação para interagir com equipes técnicas e de negócios;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes dinâmicos e de rápida transformação.

Sobre a CAPCO:

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões. 

Pensamos, em conjunto, sempre em ações diversas de inclusão e de responsabilidade social através de comitês internos geridos pela nossa comunidade interna, como os grupo de Mulheres, Pessoas Com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras, LGBTQIAPN+, Parentalidade, Gerações, entre outros.

title: Personal Assistant
description:
About Our Client

Our client is an accomplished entrepreneur and business leader managing both professional and personal commitments in a fast-paced environment. To support their activities, they are seeking a Personal Assistant who is eager to learn, highly organized, and ready to take on a variety of responsibilities.

About the Role

As a Personal Assistant, you will work closely with the CEO, providing day-to-day support across both administrative and lifestyle-related tasks. This is an entry-level opportunity well-suited for someone who is proactive, detail-oriented, and excited to grow in a dynamic international setting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist with personal and professional errands, tasks, and projects
  • Maintain clear and efficient communication with internal teams and external contacts
  • Support in preparing documents, notes, and presentations as needed
  • Ensure smooth coordination of daily priorities and commitments
  • Handle expense tracking, reimbursements, and vendor coordination
Requirements

Requirements

  • Entry-level role; some prior administrative, coordination, or assistant experience is a plus but not mandatory
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and work independently
  • Professional communication skills in Portuguese and English (written and verbal)
  • High level of discretion, reliability, and trustworthiness
  • Willingness to adapt to changing priorities and schedules
Benefits

What's on Offer

  • Full-time role based in Rio de Janeiro
  • Opportunity to work closely with a CEO and gain broad exposure to business and lifestyle management
  • Entry-level position with growth potential and career development support
  • Dynamic, international, and entrepreneurial work environment

title: Managing Director
description:
We're hiring: Managing Director / Regional Director

Location: Based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Reports to: Chief Executive Officer

Department: Executive

Role Purpose

The Managing Director / Regional Director is responsible for leading, developing, and profitably growing the company's operations within the assigned region, in alignment with the Group's overall strategy. The role aims to strengthen the organization's culture, values, and purpose while driving operational excellence, strategic leadership, and sustainable growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the regional strategy, ensuring profitability, expansion, and operational efficiency.
  • Develop and implement growth plans aligned with the company's global vision.
  • Manage the regional P&L, maximizing revenue and optimizing costs.
  • Build and lead a high-performing executive team.
  • Foster strong relationships with key clients and strategic partners.
  • Represent the company as a brand ambassador in the region.
  • Ensure compliance with global policies and local regulations.
  • Collaborate closely with the CEO and CFO on the company's strategic and financial performance.

Ideal Profile

  • Education: Bachelor's degree required; postgraduate degree preferred.
  • Experience: 10–15 years of executive-level experience, ideally in the travel or technology-enabled service industry.
  • Industry Background: Experience in a Travel Management Company (TMC) or Travel Company is mandatory.
  • Key Knowledge Areas: B2B business development, commercial growth, change management, multicultural leadership, and strategic planning.
  • Language: Fluent English (written and spoken) is essential.
  • Based in Rio de Janeiro, with availability for local and international travel

Core Competencies and Leadership Style

  • Proven ability to inspire, motivate, and develop diverse teams.
  • Excellent communication and executive influence skills.
  • Analytical, strategic mindset with a strong results orientation.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, high resilience, and execution focus.

Additional Requirements

  • Flexibility to attend corporate events and meetings outside regular working hours.

Um dos maiores grupos de beleza do mundo, o Grupo Boticário é uma empresa brasileira presente em mais de 40 países. É dono das marcas O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse, Berenice?, Vult, O.U.i, Dr. JONES,
Tô.que.tô
, TRUSS, e do marketplace Beleza na Web, além de atuar com produtos licenciados como Australian Gold, Bio Oil, Nuxe, e Pampers e sua divisão para o mercado B2B. São mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos, com mais de 4 mil lojas em 1.780 cidades brasileiras.
Vem fazer beleza com a gente

CONHEÇA O VAREJO DO GRUPO BOTICÁRIO
Somos um time de especialistas em varejo no Grupo Boticário e GENTE é o nosso negócio É a conexão das nossas histórias, nossas essências, nossas pessoas, que movidas pela paixão de fazer acontecer criam experiências INCRÍVEIS para nossos clientes e revendedores. Assim, é o varejo do GB, estamos presentes em 15 estados brasileiros e somos mais de 3.400 pessoas transformando vidas através da beleza.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Liderança e Gestão de Equipe:

  • Gerenciar e motivar uma equipe de Consultores de Vendas, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho positivo e colaborativo.
  • Realizar o planejamento estratégico de ações de vendas, alinhando-as aos objetivos da empresa.
  • Acompanhar o desempenho individual e coletivo da equipe, através de indicadores de performance (KPIs).

Análise de Desempenho e Resultados:

  • Analisar os indicadores de desempenho (boleto médio, taxa de conversão, produtividade, NPS, etc.) para identificar tendências, oportunidades e gargalos.
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias para otimizar os resultados financeiros e alcançar as metas de vendas.
  • Monitorar o mercado e a concorrência, identificando oportunidades para aumentar a competitividade.
  • Elaborar relatórios de desempenho e apresentar os resultados à gestão.

Gestão de Lojas:

  • Supervisionar a operação de 3 a 4 lojas na região do Rio de Janeiro (RJ).
  • Garantir a organização, limpeza e apresentação das lojas, assegurando uma experiência positiva para o cliente.
  • Gerenciar o estoque e os recursos das lojas, garantindo a disponibilidade de produtos e a eficiência operacional.

Marketing e Divulgação:

  • Desenvolver e implementar ações de marketing em redes sociais para divulgar produtos e serviços, visando alavancar as vendas e o reconhecimento da marca.
  • Acompanhar as métricas das campanhas de marketing e ajustar as estratégias conforme necessário.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre as tendências do mercado e as melhores práticas de marketing digital.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência no varejo.
  • Ensino superior completo ou curso em Administração, Recursos Humanos, Gestão Comercial ou aréas correlatadas .
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de equipes.
  • Forte conhecimento em indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) de vendas e análise de resultados.
  • Habilidade em desenvolver e implementar estratégias de vendas e marketing.
  • Conhecimento em vendas digital e divulgação em redes sociais.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, liderança e motivação.

title: Relocate to Malta Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement  Technical Solution Architect (Consulting/Big 4)
description:
Our client's Microsoft Business Solutions team is a Microsoft Gold Partner and leader in Microsoft software implementations for medium to large organisations, providing their clients with the ability to keep up with the ever-changing digital world by implementing Microsoft's Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Customer Engagement (CE) software from the Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) software line.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Dynamics 365 for Customer Engagement Solution Architect with experience in solution development and functional analysis into large-scale enterprise Dynamics 365 architecture with a hands-on approach in designing and leading the implementation of Dynamics 365 products, working with both onshore and offshore development teams. The focus of this role will be on all presales activities around the Dynamics 365 platform as well as methodology diagnostics and high-level solution architecting. You will also contribute to proposal development and provide input in business development while mentor junior and offshore staff.

This role is therefore kingpin to our client's customer delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 solutions. It is a dynamic and exciting opportunity to join a rapidly developing business area within an established and market-leading global firm that is our client.

Job Location: Sliema, Malta

Work Type: Hybrid

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Working Hours: GMT +1

Salary: Base + Benefits (Paid in Euros €)

Relocation: VISA & Relocation Package Included

Requirements

Experience and Background

  • Minimum of 15+ yrs of proven IT experience in implementing End-To-End Large scale solutions including Dynamics CE(CRM) & Power Platform
  • Should have architected, designed and implemented at least 7-8 full scale industry solutions using Dynamics CE (CRM), Integrations, Power Platform; Strong understanding of industry domains like Banking, Finance, Healthcare, Insurance, Telecom, Manufacturing etc.
  • Ability to architect solutions that involve multi-region implementations
  • Strong technical leadership for engagements and ability to present to the C-Suite stakeholders
  • Ability to architect and design Digital Transformation programs involving multiple technologies
  • Strong pre-sales experience/expertise with thought leadership on Solution offerings
  • Excellent presentation and demonstration skills, ability to influence and ease decision making for Senior Technical Executives of clients (CTO, Digital Transformation Officers etc.)
  • Ability to handle distributed large teams and deliver quality solutions

Skills and Qualifications

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both verbally and in writing
  • In-depth knowledge of all modules of Dynamics 365 CE, including appropriate Architect level certifications. Relevant experience on various earlier versions of Dynamics CRM like, 2016, 2015, 2013, 2011, CRM 4.0 etc.
  • Strong implementation experience with Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Apps Portals aka Power Pages, Power Automate, Power Virtual Agents, Power BI, RPA etc.), including appropriate Architect level certification
  • Broad understanding of software development lifecycle, Development management, Release management, Data migration, cut-over planning and Go-Live support
  • Exposure in Cloud Storage Services (Azure SQL, Blob storage etc.)
  • Experience with Azure Platform and Integration Services including LogicApps, Functions, Azure Service Bus etc.
  • Experience working with offshore development teams
  • Experience of Agile Methodology
  • Certification in TOGAF or Zachman Framework would be beneficial
  • Knowledge of other Marketing products are desirable – Click Dimension or Adobe Marketing Cloud, D365 for Marketing etc.
  • Graduate from a recognized University with majors in computational (Computer Science, Information Technology etc.) discipline

Responsibilities

  • The Solution Architect will lead the delivery of our Microsoft Dynamics 365 solutions
  • Be a champion/SME (Subject Matter Expert) for both technical and functional solutions across the Microsoft platform, driving the adoption of new features and technology
  • Possess strong understanding of Dynamics 365 & power platform stack and stay relevant with new features
  • Lead technical forums and communities to share knowledge with wider group
  • Design and development of domain specific implementations; Influence usage of out of the box Dynamics 365 functionality, giving our client a competitive advantage
  • Identify skilling opportunities and define training needs within the team; Coach other team members and help in reducing skills gaps
  • Identify opportunities and work for industry specific Solution Offerings that will be market differentiator for our client
  • Meet and exceed customer expectations on business knowledge, skills and behaviour
  • Identify business/project risk and mitigate or communicate as necessary
  • Ensure progress updates are communicated to relevant parties both formally and informally
  • Identify practice development activities and help in defining how these will be delivered
  • A portion of the role requires supporting and doing people management, people development & career progression support, performance assessment and management (especially for other Technical Architects)
  • In all activities, ensure timely completion of internal processes and mandatory training
  • Willing to travel abroad when required
  • To carry out additional duties as may occur from time to time as instructed and agreed by the Practice management team
  • Provide on-site support as required by company or client
  • Performance manage and/or mentor junior members of the team
  • Always represent our client in a professional and positive manner
  • The Employee is required to follow our client's Information Security Policies (ISP and ISMP) at all times

title: Senior Telco Service Engineer
description:
Job Description

Tietoevry Create welcomes talented professionals to join our project and to work as a Senior Telco Service Engineer for our respectful client BICS.

Are you ready to make an impact in a global telecom leader with a diverse and innovative product portfolio? BICS is looking for a dedicated Service Engineer to support key international clients across our extensive range of telecom services. In this role, you'll collaborate closely with both technical and commercial teams, ensuring seamless service delivery and building long-term strategic partnerships. You'll be the primary after-sales contact, managing complex service issues and tailoring operational approaches to meet each customer's unique needs—all within a dynamic, international environment.

Your Responsibilities

  • Act as the main point of contact for selected key international customers, ensuring seamless service delivery across BICS' diverse and innovative telecom portfolio.
  • Build long-term strategic partnerships through customized operational interfaces and proactive engagement, working closely with both technical and commercial teams to align on customer needs.
  • Prepare and present monthly performance reports, lead Service Review Meetings, and drive continuous improvement through corrective actions and follow-up.
  • Serve as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) during incidents or escalations, delivering detailed event analyses, corrective action plans, and formal RFO/RCA documentation.
  • Advise customers on process improvements, reporting tools, and new services/products, helping them unlock the full potential of BICS's global offerings.
  • Share customer feedback internally to promote operational excellence, foster innovation, and support cross-functional collaboration.
  • Develop and maintain operational manuals detailing service processes, planned work procedures, and escalation matrices to ensure consistency and transparency.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Solid background in the Telecom industry, with a strong technical foundation and experience in customer-facing roles.
  • A customer-oriented mindset with strong analytical capabilities, empathy, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Technical knowledge of message flows in Voice, Signalling, and Roaming scenarios, with the ability to translate complex issues into actionable solutions.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken; additional languages are a plus in our global environment.
  • University degree in Telecommunications or equivalent professional experience.
  • Flexibility, accountability, and willingness to travel internationally. Strong crisis management skills are essential.
  • A passion for working in a global, cross-functional setting, collaborating with experts across technical and commercial domains to deliver world-class service.

This role demands a blend of technical proficiency, customer relationship management, and communication skills to ensure high-quality service delivery and customer satisfaction.

title: Contract Manager
description:
Contract Manager

Wärtsilä is an innovative technology company known for being a forerunner in the Marine and Energy markets. Every day, we – Wärtsilians - put our hearts and minds into turning Wärtsilä's purpose of enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services into reality. Our ultimate aim is to provide increased value to both our customers and society. New, game-changing ideas and continuous improvement have been part of our DNA since 1834. Together, we can create new business opportunities and more sustainable future that we can all be proud of.

We want to transition the world towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. By pushing the boundaries of engineering and technology, we can make it work. We are always on the lookout for future-oriented talent – want to join the ride?

We are looking for a Contract Manager to join our Service Delivery Operations of Gas Solutions team. In this position, you will report to the Service Delivery Operations Manager in Wärtsilä, and the location of the position is in Rio de Janeiro/RJ, Brazil.

What you will be doing?

You will establish and ensure good relations with customers. Daily, you will be in contact with sales and field service team to meet customers' needs.
For us to be the best match, we expect you to have knowledge of the maritime business, SAP and Salesforce systems. You have a bachelor's degree in engineering and other professional achievements related to project/contract/client management. You are eager to support other team members to achieve common success. You can set your work's priorities and work without supervision.

** PLEASE SUBMIT RESUMES IN ENGLISH **

Your work will focus on these responsibilities:

  • Close follow up and reporting of the portfolio financial status, including agreements, service missions and service projects.
  • Coordinate single and/or standard Field Service work orders.
  • Plan activities, resources, spare parts, costs and time schedule for the work orders.
  • Coordinate people when they are assigned on a work order.
  • Act as contact person for customer during the work order.
  • Interact with relevant internal stakeholders in Gas Solutions.
  • Ensure that the work is executed according to Wärtsila Quality, Health, Safety and Environmental guidelines and customer site procedures.
  • Follow up and report the status of the work order to customer and relevant internal stakeholders.
  • Building trust within the team, supporting growing department.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering completed
  • Experience in oil and gas/offshore business
  • Excellent communication skills and advanced English
  • Experience with budget management
  • Knowledge of SAP and CRM (Salesforce)
  • Knowledge of maritime law (desirable)
  • Proactive approach and "can do" attitude
  • Able to work under pressure

Last application date: 04/12/2025

At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job-relevant merits and abilities.

Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country.

Em 2024, fomos eleitos, pelo 8º ano consecutivo, uma ótima empresa para se trabalhar pela consultoria Great Place to Work (GPTW).

Mais do que uma atividade empresarial, encaramos a universalização do saneamento básico como um compromisso de larga escala com a vida, as pessoas, o meio ambiente, os parceiros e o desenvolvimento sustentável do Brasil.

O nosso jeito de ser é marcado pelo DNA inovador que proporciona um ambiente acolhedor, respeitoso e de muitos aprendizados, gerando grande impacto na sociedade. A valorização e o respeito as diferenças estão presentes na empresa para promover uma cultura ética e inclusiva sempre e um ambiente psicologicamente seguro para mulheres, pessoas com deficiência, pessoas negras, pessoas LGBTQIA+, independente de suas crenças, idade ou qualquer outro marcador social ou identitário. Buscamos a equidade e respeito e em nossas equipes então venha fazer parte dessa mudança, acreditamos na força de cada individualidade para gerar transformação Já somos mais de 2.500 colaboradores e estamos expandindo em um ritmo acelerado e com perspectiva para muito mais

title: Analista de Cadastro Sênior
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Aegea
Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária
A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom
O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.
Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Tratamento, análise e interpretação da base de dados comercial de forma gerencial;
  • Tratamento, análise e interpretação da base de dados técnicos de forma gerencial;

  • Cruzamento de grande volume de informações via QGIS, Excel Avançado, Power BI e ArcGis;
  • Estudos e análises de grande complexibilidade em temas Regulatórios (Cobertura, Faixa "Non Aedificandi") e Orçamentários (Plano de Investimento);

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino superior completo em Geografia, Arquitetura, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento em Geoprocessamento, QGIS, Arcgis;

Informações adicionais

  • Assistência médica;

  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados.

Rio


Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

Estamos selecionando um(a) Tech Lead (.NET & Angular) para atuar em um projeto estratégico em um de nossos principais clientes, uma empresa de alta complexidade e missão crítica no setor de Energia.

Procuramos um profissional Sênior que queira assumir um papel de liderança técnica, sendo a principal ponte entre as áreas de Negócio e os times de desenvolvimento (fábrica).

Seu papel não será o desenvolvimento "hands-on" diário, mas sim a governança técnica, o relacionamento com stakeholders e a orientação da equipe. Você será a referência que entende profundamente da tecnologia para definir soluções, mas também atuará no "incêndio", colocando a mão na massa quando incidentes críticos exigirem sua expertise técnica.

Interface de negócio: Ser o canal de comunicação principal com as áreas usuárias , realizando o levantamento de requisitos e traduzindo as necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis.

Governança técnica: Orientar a fábrica de software, questionar soluções, validar estimativas e garantir a qualidade das entregas e a aderência à arquitetura definida.

Análise e solução: Atuar na análise inicial de problemas e novas implementações, propondo soluções e depurando sistemas em cenários complexos.

Gestão de crise (Hands-on pontual): Liderar a resolução de problemas críticos em produção, atuando tecnicamente quando necessário.

Gestão de esteira: Supervisionar e entender o processo de build e deploy , gestão de branchs e a administração da esteira de CI/CD (incluindo ambientes em OpenShift ).

Experiência consolidada (mínimo 5 anos ) em desenvolvimento, arquitetura ou liderança técnica.

Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática em C# .NET (Core e Framework) e Angular.

Sólidos conhecimentos em Modelagem de Banco de Dados (preferencialmente SQL Server) e linguagem SQL.

Experiência em metodologias ágeis e tradicionais de desenvolvimento.

Vivência anterior atuando como interface direta com usuários ou áreas de negócio (levantamento de requisitos, definição de escopo).

Inglês Intermediário para leitura e escrita de documentação técnica.

Diferenciais (Desejáveis):

Conhecimento em Mensageria (principalmente Kafka ).

Vivência com ambientes de containers (preferencialmente OpenShift, Docker ou Kubernetes ).

Conhecimento em Arquitetura de TI e Integração de Sistemas.

Pós-graduação na área de Tecnologia. ;

title: Senior Associate
description:
This role is based in our office in Rio de Janeiro. As a Senior Associate, you will report to the Line Manager.

As a Senior Associate, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the accurate and timely processing of Net Asset Values (NAV) for assigned funds, along with overseeing investor allocations and financial operations. You will serve as the primary contact for client communications and audits, while also collaborating with various internal teams to enhance operational efficiency. This position demands a strong understanding of financial operations, regulatory compliance, and the ability to manage complex client relationships.

From a high-level perspective, the core responsibilities that form your role are broken down into the following 7 categories:

  1. NAV Calculation and Investor Allocations
  2. Client Communications and Audit Management
  3. Financial Operations
  4. Collaboration and Coordination
  5. Audit and Financial Statement Preparation
  6. System Setup and Client Onboarding
  7. Risk and Compliance Responsibilities

Your Daily Tasks

The following are the tasks linked to the Core Responsibilities that will be expected as part of this role:  

1. NAV Calculation and Investor Allocations:

Includes (but not limited to) the following tasks:

a) NAV Support: Collaborate with the operations team to calculate the Net Asset Value of assigned funds, ensuring accurate investor allocations.

b) Expense Management: Monitor bank accounts and client communications to ensure the accurate booking of expenses related to the funds.

2. Client Communications and Audit Management:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

a) Client Liaison: Act as the lead point of contact for all client communications and audits, ensuring that all inquiries are addressed promptly and effectively.

b) Audit Coordination: Coordinate with FS Prep Team and external auditors to facilitate the audit process, ensuring all required documentation is prepared and provided.

3. Financial Operations:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

a) Fee Calculations: Set-up and calculate management fees, carried interest, and performance fees for the funds, along with ensuring accurate period accruals.

b) Pricing & Valuation: Price all investments held by the fund using Bloomberg or third-party pricing support, ensuring accuracy and compliance with industry standards.

c) Reconciliation: Process trades, positions, P&L, and cash reconciliations. Develop and implement new reconciliation templates using data management tools. 

4. Collaboration and Coordination:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

a) Team Liaison: Work closely with the Investor Services and Treasury Services teams for activities related to the funds under your supervision.

b) Client Implementation: Assist in managing the client implementation process for new business, ensuring the timely rollout of NAV packs and associated deliverables.

5. Audit and Financial Statement Preparation

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

  1. Financial Reporting: Manage the year-end audit and financial statement preparation process for all assigned funds, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies.

6. System Setup and Client Onboarding

Includes (but not limited to) the following tasks:

a) Client Onboarding: Lead the operations team in client onboarding processes and system setups, focusing on interface programming and portfolio reporting.

b) Process Understanding: Develop a thorough understanding of the structure, capital activity processes, waterfall calculations, and valuation intricacies for both closed-ended and open-ended funds.

7. Risk and Compliance Responsibilities:

Includes (but not limited to) the following tasks:

a) Compliance Tasks: Perform routine compliance checks and adhere to company risk and compliance processes and policies.

b) Control Testing: Participate in testing of operational controls and report findings.

c) Compliance Culture - Working in tandem with Manager and Risk and Governance colleagues to instill a culture that is centered around good governance and compliance.

d) Documentation Review: Review documentation to ensure compliance with policies.

e) Support Investigations: Assist in compliance investigations and gather necessary information.

f) Learning and Development: Engage in learning opportunities to understand compliance principles and regulations.

Additional Strategic Expectations

  • Share insights to enable development of new processes and procedures that will create business efficiency and support delivery of client excellence in service.
  • Maintain awareness of industry, regulatory, jurisdictional, and other trends that could affect the business.
  • Contribute to the creation, development and implementation of new products and solutions to accommodate the businesses continuous changing needs.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with operations staff, business users, project, and implementation managers to achieve desired and elegant solutions.

Required Skills & Experience

Are you getting excited? We are Before we get too carried away, there are a few requirements you'll need to check off before you can apply for the position:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field. Professional certification (CFA, CAIA, CPA, etc.) is a plus.
  • Experience: 3+ years of experience in private equity fund administration or a similar role, with a focus on NAV calculations, financial reporting, and investor allocations.
  • Familiarity with private equity fund administration software such as Investran, Bloomberg, eFront, or similar systems.
  • Strong Excel skills, including data analysis, financial modeling, and report generation.
  • Solid understanding of fund structures, including capital calls, distributions, and performance metrics (IRR, multiple invested capital).

title: Analista de Facilities e Viagens
description:
POR QUE SER UM VOLTALIEN?

Na Voltalia somos apaixonados pela ideia de um mundo mais sustentável, limpo e inclusivo Acima de tudo buscamos fazer a diferença nas regiões onde atuamos, pois somos uma empresa orientada para nossa missão de melhorar o meio ambiente global, promovendo o desenvolvimento local.

Nossos Valores são: Integridade, Destreza, Empreendedorismo e Espírito de Equipe
. Dentro dessas premissas o respeito nos norteia, por isso, para todas as nossas vagas, valorizamos a diversidade em sua amplitude independente de cor, religião, idade, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero.

Nascemos em 2005 na França e atualmente somos uma empresa de capital aberto na Euronext Paris. Estamos em 20 países, divididos em 4 continentes e oferecemos capacidade operacional global aos nossos clientes.

Atuamos como produtores de energia eólica, solar, hidro, biomassa e soluções de armazenamento. Somos também prestadores de serviços à terceiros como Desenvolvimento, EPC, O&M e Distribuição.

#proudtobeVoltalia

  • Gestão de toda a logística de viagens nacionais e internacionais para colaboradores e terceiros (hospedagens, passagens, locação de veículos, transfers, etc) do escopo Latam e apoio a Europa
  • Utilização de sistemas selfbooking
  • Apoio e na elaboração e acompanhamento de budget (real x orçado)
  • Controle de alojamentos
  • Conferência e controle de reembolsos de despesas (viagens e administrativas)
  • Conferência de faturamentos e pagamentos da área
  • Aplicação de treinamentos para os colaboradores referentes a ferramentas selfbooking e Expenses (reembolsos de despesas)
  • Apoio na organização de eventos externos e internos (Seminários, Eventos para Liderança e etc.)
  • Acompanhamento de rotina da área de Facilities /Administração de Terceiros (Manutenção, Copa, Limpeza)
  • Apoio na área de HSE para escritórios corporativos.

A ENERGIA QUE PRECISAMOS

  • Formação acadêmica.
  • 3 anos de experiência nas atividades descritas
  • Inglês avançado e Espanhol intermediário
  • Excel intermediário

A FONTE DE ENERGIA QUE PRECISAMOS

  • Organização
  • Flexibilidade
  • Senso de urgência
  • Comunicação
  • Trabalho em equipe, Empreendedorismo, Integridade e Inovação são valores requeridos para todos os colaboradores do grupo e, é claro, ser gente boa

COMO VIVEMOS AQUI

Nossa energia de startup está presente no dia a dia, por meio do trabalho em equipe em um ambiente descontraído, criativo e sustentável

Aqui na Voltalia, ousamos em renovar. Buscamos trabalhar de maneira unida e diversa porque acreditamos que, dessa forma, desenhamos nossa essência em cada projeto realizado.

Voltaliens são a nossa maior energia Por isso, pensamos diariamente em nosso desenvolvimento. Temos o foco em soluções porque temos um objetivo em comum: melhorar o nosso ecossistema.

title: Evolved Packet Core
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

As a Network Architect, in the Network Team, you will be responsible to propose, analyze and define the requirements for new and existing services and systems, in the functional domain of Evolved Packet Core and 5G SA Core.

You will be responsible for preparing, designing, testing, and delivering new solutions or enhancements to the existing product portfolio. Additionally, you will define and support the technology evolution roadmap for systems within the assigned functional area and domain, while also actively participating in and supporting cross-functional projects in collaboration with other functional areas.
Key Responsibilities

  • Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing the projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery. Network design. Integration and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments. Responsible for end-to-end delivery
  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Creation of technical documentation (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.) and maintain it over the lifecycle of the solutions
  • Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Service & Resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Elaborate, and manage the process, for change requests to current partners in order to meet the network necessities
  • Control the network elements roadmap, being responsible for the necessary software/hardware upgrade during the components lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including and especially cross-team processes
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry. Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives

Requirements

Must Have

  • Proven experience on implementation of live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience in the design, test and operation of Packet Core systems, including P-GW, RADIUS, DNS, PCRF, ePDG, DRA
  • Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining roaming interconnects for GRX/IPX
  • Understanding about IMS architecture. Experience in deploying VoLTE, VoWiFi, and QoS
  • Experience in designing, implementing, testing and troubleshooting the following interfaces: Gx, RADIUS, SGi/Gi, Gy, Bp, S6b, S2b, SWm, Sxb
  • Experience in mobile services charging (offline, online).
  • Experience in Policy control, including DPI and PCRF policy creation
  • Experience with IoT, including LTE-M and NB-IoT
  • Knowledge and experience with Diameter/SCTP networks and protocols
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as RADIUS, GTP-C, GTP-U, Diameter, MAP, S6a
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot networks errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience


Nice to Have

  • +8 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
  • +3 years in a telecom strategy role
  • Experience in 5G Core design, implementation and operation
  • Previous experience with Nokia and Affirmed Networks EPC products

Benefits

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave - 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave.
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

title: Consultor
description:
Descrição do perfil

Responsável por garantir o gerenciamento de risco de tecnologia.

Principais atividades

  • Realizar análise de projetos corporativos, identificando fragilidades técnicas e processuais relacionadas à Segurança da Informação e Proteção de Dados;
  • Conduzir avaliações de riscos em ativos tecnológicos (sistemas, redes, dispositivos de segurança, sites e aplicações) em ambientes On Premises e Cloud Computing (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS);
  • Acompanhar, em conjunto com áreas de TI e Negócio, a implementação de planos de ação e controles mitigatórios decorrentes das análises de risco e revisões de projetos;
  • Monitorar e reportar o andamento dos planos de ação relacionados a vulnerabilidades e não conformidades, garantindo mitigação dentro dos prazos definidos;
  • Apoiar a análise de projetos estratégicos, assegurando conformidade com requisitos legais, regulatórios e de segurança corporativa;
  • Avaliar riscos e controles internos (tecnológicos e processuais), alinhando-os às boas práticas de governança e frameworks de mercado;
  • Conduzir avaliações de fornecedores em processos de RFP/RFQ/RFI, analisando riscos de tecnologia e de negócio associados à contratação de soluções e serviços;
  • Avaliar e aprovar demandas relacionadas à VPN Site-to-Site, assegurando integração segura com fornecedores externos;
  • Apoiar a revisão e atualização de políticas, normas, processos e controles internos relacionados à Segurança da Informação, Governança de TI e práticas de desenvolvimento seguro;
  • Realizar a triagem e o encaminhamento das demandas provenientes do sistema de demandas, garantindo correta priorização e alocação das atividades.

Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação

  • Experiência comprovada em Gestão de Riscos, Análise de Projetos e Segurança da Informação;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks e normas de referência, tais como ISO 27001, ISO 27005, NIST CSF, COBIT e ITIL;
  • Vivência com Cloud Security (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) e análise de riscos em ambientes híbridos;
  • Conhecimento em avaliação de fornecedores de TI e processos de Third Party Risk Management (TPRM);
  • Experiência em análise de vulnerabilidades e acompanhamento de planos de mitigação;
  • Conhecimento em gestão de políticas, normas e controles de segurança da informação;
  • Obrigatório Superior completo, preferencialmente em Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

title: Líder de Almoxarifado
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We're a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we've grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne, Panadol, Advil, Voltaren, Theraflu, Otrivin, and Centrum – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it's time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Quer fazer parte de uma empresa líder mundial em saúde do consumidor que tem como propósito entregar a maior saúde diária com humanidade? Quer contribuir para impactar a vida de bilhões de pessoas por meio de grandes e reconhecidas marcas, como Sensodyne, Centrum, Advil, Eno, Sonrisal, Corega, CataflamPro, Sonridor e outras, e poder ir além em um ambiente que celebra a diversidade?

Então, confira a oportunidade abaixo e venha fazer parte do nosso time Haleon

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como ponto focal na gestão administrativa do almoxarifado, com ênfase na análise de dados operacionais, acompanhamento de KPIs e desenvolvimento de ferramentas de controle (torre de controle) que suportem a tomada de decisão e a melhoria contínua dos processos logísticos;
  • Efetuar a coordenação direta da equipe do almoxarifado responsável pelas atividades do armazém e suporte direto à produção, estabelecendo atividades e avaliando desempenho por meio de índices internos, a fim de proporcionar o nível de serviço adequado, atendendo aos requerimentos de qualidade e segurança;
  • Monitorar e analisar indicadores-chave de desempenho do almoxarifado, como acuracidade de inventário, tempo de atendimento, produtividade e SLA de abastecimento;
  • Desenvolver e manter dashboards e relatórios gerenciais utilizando ferramentas como Excel, Power BI ou similares;
  • Estruturar e implementar a torre de controle da área, garantindo visibilidade em tempo real das operações e desvios;
  • Apoiar a Gerência e seus pares com análises de causa raiz e planos de ação baseados em dados;
  • Liderar projetos com foco em sustentabilidade e segurança;
  • Interagir com áreas como Planejamento, Compras, Produção e Qualidade para melhoria de fluxo, redução de desvios e busca por projetos de net savings;
  • Conduzir investigação de desvios e definição de planos de ação adequados para evitar recorrências.

Por que VOCÊ?

Suas qualificações:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração, Engenharia, Farmácia, Logística, Engenharia de Dados ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência em operações logísticas, preferencialmente em almoxarifado ou centro de distribuição;
  • Desejável experiência com liderança de equipe;
  • Conhecimento em gestão de contratos e orçamentos;
  • Pacote Office e Power BI avançados;
  • Inglês avançado.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em metodologias Lean e Six Sigma;
  • Experiência com Power Apps e Power Automate;
  • Python avançado;
  • Domínio em sistema WMS e ERP SAP (Módulo MM).

Job Posting End Date

Equal Opportunities

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It's important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

Adjustment or Accommodations Request

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We'll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

Note to candidates

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account ). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Partnership Business Development Executive
description:
ABOUT US

Chiliz - the world's leading sports-focused blockchain Tech company, is leading the charge into Web3, building a global ecosystem where fans don't just watch the game—they become a part of it. If you're ready to put on your jersey and get to work alongside a dynamic global team, this could be the perfect match.

OUR BRANDS

  • Chiliz:
    The backbone of our ecosystem, creator of Chiliz Chain - the Layer 1 blockchain that powers our vision of Web3 for sports and entertainment.
  • Fan Tokens:
    Official Digital Assets for more than 70 of the world's biggest sports teams, including giants like Paris Saint Germain, Man City, FC Barcelona
    .
  • :
    The Web3 Fan Token Wallet and home of Fan Token rewards.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a self-starter with exceptional business acumen who can navigate complex stakeholder environments. You should be comfortable operating independently while collaborating across teams, possess strong analytical capabilities, and demonstrate genuine enthusiasm for the intersection of sports, technology, and finance. Your ability to identify creative partnership opportunities and execute them will be critical to success in this role.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Identify, evaluate, and develop strategic partnerships with retail networks, financial institutions, investment firms, and other potential distribution channels for fan tokens and Chiliz products
  • Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers across banking, sports organizations, and crypto-related businesses in Brazil
  • Create compelling business proposals, pitch decks, and partnership frameworks tailored to prospective partners' needs and objectives
  • Conduct market analysis to identify emerging opportunities and competitive dynamics in the Brazilian digital asset and sports engagement landscape
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful partnership implementation and ongoing relationship management
  • Represent at industry events, conferences, and client meetings
  • Track partnership performance metrics and provide regular reports on business development activities and pipeline status

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in business development, sales, or partnerships, preferably within the financial services/banking sector. Preferably knowledge of web3, and could be sports related.
  • Proven track record of successfully closing complex B2B partnerships and achieving revenue targets
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian financial services landscape and regulatory environment
  • Excellent presentation and negotiation skills with ability to influence C-level executives
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (written and verbal)
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or related field
  • Preferred Qualifications
  • Direct experience or demonstrated interest in sports industry partnerships and sponsorships
  • Knowledge of cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, and digital asset markets
  • Existing network within Brazilian banking, retail, or investment sectors
  • Experience drafting commercial agreements and partnership terms

What We Offer:

The chance to join a global community of sports blockchain enthusiasts spanning 6 countries and over 40 nationalities, committed to building a vibrant, exciting Web3 future for sports alongside some of the biggest names on the planet. We're looking for team players who are happy to try, fail, and bounce back—because a great team is all about the comeback.

We believe the interview process is a two-way street. Think of it as a draft where we're both trying to make the best pick. Our competitive salaries, wellness allowance, healthcare, and pension plans are just the tip of the iceberg. You'll be joining a diverse, global team, where flexibility and challenge are part of the playbook.

Ready to play? Let's get to work.

title: Linux Administrator
description:
At Keywords, we are using our passion for games, technology and media to create a global services platform for video games and beyond. Our aim is to become the "go to" provider of technical services.

We enable leading content creators and publishers to leverage our expertise and capacity across the lifecycle of interactive content. In so doing we empower our clients to remain lean and agile, and to focus on creating the most engaging experiences.

Keywords is trusted and relied upon by many of the world's leading video game companies to work alongside them during concept, development and live operations by leveraging the breadth and depth of our industry leading service lines every step of the way.

We are seeking an experienced Linux Administrator to support the technology initiatives of the IT Infrastructure team at Keywords. Linux Administrator will be responsible for follow-the-sun delivery and support of related services, prompt reaction on Linux infrastructure incidents as 2nd line support and cooperation with other infrastructure teams for resolution.

Main Responsibilities

  • Ensure that all escalated incidents are handled within SLA's.
  • Act as expert support for Linux stack related incidents and support requests.
  • Installation, configuration, and support of Linux environment.
  • Manage problem resolution with third party vendors.
  • Participate in Problem management processes.
  • Support company Linux infrastructure on premise and in a Cloud
  • Provide operational administration and configuration support for highly available server landscapes.
  • Deliver new services according to the business requirements.
  • Participate in integration projects, ensuring that new existing studios are brought to the latest infrastructure standards.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and efficiency enhancements.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation on all system designs and configurations, troubleshooting procedures.
Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field or equivalent experience
  • Strong understanding of Linux stack technologies, standards and trends
  • Strong technical background with 5+ years' experience Linux stack administration
  • Strong technical knowledge of Storage and Server equipment, virtualization and production setups
  • Advanced experience of building and troubleshooting Linux OS environments
  • Strong technical knowledge of Cloud Infrastructure, Azure, AWS
  • Experience with scripting with Shell/PowerShell, Bash, Python, and/or Git
  • Puppet and/or Ansible configuration management
  • Experience with Docker
  • Experience with IT infrastructure migrations
  • Strong understanding of Infrastructure change management
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and ability to identify and resolve complex IT infrastructure issues
  • Strong decision-making skills
  • Strong understanding of gaming industry dynamics and trends, with a passion for gaming

To be considered for the position, please ensure your CV is submitted in English.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Company overview:

Blue Orange Digital is a boutique data & AI consultancy that delivers enterprise-grade results. We design and build modern data platforms, analytics, and ML/AI Agent solutions for mid‑market and enterprise clients across Private Equity, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Retail.

Our teams work with technologies like Databricks, Snowflake, dbt, and the broader Microsoft ecosystem to turn messy, real-world data into trustworthy, actionable insight.

We're a builder‑led, client‑first culture that prizes ownership, clear communication, and shipping high‑impact work.

Note: Please submit your resume in English, as all application materials must be in English for review and consideration.

Position overview:

Blue Orange is seeking to expand our team of expert consultants with multiple experienced Data Engineers to address a set of expanding opportunities in the next several months. Our engineers require a diverse skill set, including system administration, DevOps, infrastructure automation, data modeling, and workflow orchestration. Blue Orange builds enterprise data platforms and systems for a variety of clients, so this candidate should have experience with supporting modern data technologies. The ideal candidate will have experience with multiple data engineering technologies across multiple clouds and deployment scenarios. In particular, we're looking for someone with experience with Azure DevOps, Databricks, and Python.

Responsibilities:

  • Work with data teams to help design, build, and deploy data platforms in the cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP) and automate their operation.
  • Work with Azure DevOps, Azure Pipelines, Terraform, CloudFormation, and other automation and infrastructure tools to build robust systems.
  • Work with Databricks, Spark, Python, and other data orchestration and ETL tools to build high-performance data pipelines.
  • Provide leadership in applying software development principles and best practices, including Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery/Deployment, and managing Infrastructure as Code, and Automated Testing across multiple software applications.
  • Support heterogeneous technology environments, including both Windows and Linux systems.
  • Develop reusable, automated processes and custom tools.

Requirements:

  • BA/BS degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • At least 2 years of experience building and supporting data platforms; exposure to data technologies like Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Airflow, Spark, etc.
  • Experience with Cloud Data Platforms, like Snowflake and Databricks.
  • Advanced-level Python, SQL, and Bash scripting.
  • Experience designing and building robust CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong Linux system administration skills.
  • Comfortable with Docker, configuration management, and monitoring tools.
  • Knowledge of best practices related to security, performance, and disaster recovery.
  • Experience working in cloud environments, with a minimum of experience in Azure and AWS.
  • Enjoys collaborating with other engineers on architecture and sharing designs with the team.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication.
  • Interacts with others using sound judgment, good humor, and consistent fairness in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Hold certifications for Azure DevOps, Azure Data Fundamentals, Databricks, and Snowflake.

Benefits:

  • Fully remote
  • Flexible Schedule
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid parental/bereavement leave
  • Worldwide recognized clients to build skills for an excellent resume
  • Top-notch team to learn and grow with

Salary: USD $6,825 - $8,350 (monthly salary range)

Background checks may be required for certain positions/projects.

Blue Orange Digital is an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Coordenador(a) de Projetos
description:
Gestão do Controle de Implantação (Rollout Control Management): Responsável por coordenar e monitorar todas as etapas do processo de implantação, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos, escopo e qualidade definidos.

Atualização de Metas (Target Update): Realizar revisões periódicas das metas do projeto, ajustando indicadores conforme o progresso e mudanças estratégicas;

Acompanhamento de Status Congelado (Frozen Follow-up): Monitorar e reportar atividades ou entregas que estejam em status de congelamento, identificando causas e propondo soluções para retomada;

Acompanhamento de MOS (MOS Follow-up): Gerenciar o cumprimento dos procedimentos operacionais definidos (Method of Statement ou Management Operating System), assegurando alinhamento entre equipes e conformidade com padrões técnicos;

Acompanhamento de Instalação (Installation Follow-up): Supervisionar o progresso das atividades de instalação, garantindo que sejam realizadas conforme os requisitos técnicos e dentro dos prazos estabelecidos;

Acompanhamento de Aceite (Acceptance Follow-up): Controlar o processo de aceite das entregas do projeto, validando documentação, testes e conformidade técnica junto aos stakeholders;

Gestão de Projetos: Atuar em projetos de média a alta complexidade, exigindo habilidades de planejamento, análise de riscos, comunicação entre áreas e tomada de decisão estratégica.

Requisitos:

Ensino superior completo em Engenharia, Administração, Logística, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;

Certificações em gestão de projetos (desejável): PMP, Scrum, Prince2;

Experiência com gestão de projetos técnicos e/ou de implantação (rollout, aceitação);

Conhecimento em metodologias de acompanhamento de projetos (ex: MOS, Agile, PMBOK);

Capacidade de realizar follow-up estruturado com múltiplas equipes (instalação, aceite, metas);

Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão de projetos (ex: MS Project, Jira, Trello, SAP);

Habilidade para lidar com projetos de média a alta complexidade;

Experiência com controle de cronogramas, entregas e documentação técnica;

title: Instrument Technician
description:
Instrument Technician

Req Id: 20623

Job Family: Instrumentation & Controls Offshore (ICSS)

Location:Rio de Janeiro, BR,

Description:

Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. Now, see how a role change can develop you, and us, even more.

About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production in offshore oil and gas. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise. It means continuing to enable decarbonization and support the energy transition, while diversifying our unique capabilities to help more blue economy industries grow and thrive sustainably. Through our strategy of Advancing Our Core and Pioneering More and our values of Care, Integrity, Collaboration, and Ownership, we are sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

Reports To

  • Instrument Supervisor

Background

  • The Technician is responsible for executing maintenance and preservation tasks efficiently and safely to ensure the reliability and longevity of equipment. This role involves performing a variety of maintenance and preservation activities, including but not limited to cleaning, housekeeping, blasting, spraying/painting, isolation and reinstatement, greasing application, and the preservation of topside items like flanges, bolts and valves.
  • The technician is also responsible for ensuring that his supervisor is made aware of all activities according to procedure, especially when safety is an issue.
  • The technician/operator will demonstrate exemplary safety awareness and technical competence in all aspects of maintenance and preservation work on and around the vessel.

Authority

  • The Instrument Technician is authorized to maintain Instrument assets and systems safely.

Immediate Subordinates

  • Subcontractors, Visitors, Vendor Representatives

Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards

  • 1) Dismantle and Reassemble Instrumentation Equipment
  • 1
  • Identify potential sources of hazard prior to dismantling.
  • 2
  • Use correct procedures and correct method of dismantling.
  • 3
  • Carry out the correct isolation and disconnection procedure.
  • 4
  • Identify, check and prepare components.
  • 5
  • Apply appropriate tests and test equipment to ensure reassembly is correct and effective.
  • 2) Monitor and Maintain the condition of Instrumentation Equipment.
  • 1
  • Adjust instruments to meet the operating specification.
  • 2
  • Adjust with minimum disruption to any ongoing activities and minimum waste of resources.
  • 3
  • Monitor and record what has been carried out in work history or log.
  • 3) Diagnose Faults in Equipment.
  • 1
  • Respond promptly to problems in line with approved procedures.
  • 2
  • Select appropriate tests and diagnostic procedures and apply them methodically.
  • 3
  • Carry out Visual, Close and Detailed inspections on 'Ex' equipment.
  • 4
  • Use the results of inspections to determine the appropriate actions to take.
  • 5
  • Record an accurate and full description in the appropriate document history.
  • 4) Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures.
  • 1
  • Unplanned discharges to the environment are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to policy, procedure and regulation.
  • 2
  • Relevant PPE is used to deal with unplanned discharges using company procedures.
  • 3
  • Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.
  • 4
  • Environmental protection and pollution control are enforced effectively with colleagues, subordinates and subcontractors.
  • 5) Emergency Response
  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.

Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies

Offshore - Demonstrate an Understanding of PandIds

Offshore - Handover

Offshore - Diagnosis and Fault Finding

Offshore - Reports

Offshore - Computerised Maintenance Management System

Offshore - Planning Work

Offshore - Dismantling, Repair and Reassemble Equipment

Offshore - Hazardous Area Classification

Offshore - Safety Management

Pre-hire Qualifications and Experience

  • Proven experience and/or qualified to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Instrument Engineering or local equivalent.
  • Experience desired with offshore experience preferred.
  • Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing systems and utilities.
  • Good experience of Permit to Work, Instrument/Mechanical Isolation Standards and Risk Assessment.
  • COMP ex E'X' course preferred.
  • Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

GENERAL INFORMATION

SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group ("the Company"). All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

title: Assessor(a) Tributário
description:
Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você.

Em Impostos, estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando organizações a prosperar em uma era de mudanças rápidas. Oferecemos serviços em todas as disciplinas tributárias e combinamos nosso conhecimento e experiência com as pessoas e as melhores plataformas de tecnologia; e isso nos torna um parceiro ideal para as necessidades relacionadas a impostos sobre transações, impostos internacionais e questões fiscais relacionadas a pessoas, conformidade e relatórios, entre outros. #TaxEY

Oportunidade disponível para atuação híbrida no escritório de São Paulo.

#hibrido 

Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito? 

Como pessoa Assessora Tributária, você ajudará nossos clientes com os aspectos e complexidades fiscais de situações e transações transfronteiriças incluindo análises, relatórios e gestão de riscos.  Você poderá contar com ferramentas, conhecimentos e oportunidades para avançar e assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Atuar em projetos de estruturação de investimentos no Brasil e/ou no exterior, auxiliando nossos clientes a buscar sempre a solução mais adequada para o seu empreendimento, facilitando processos decisórios;
  • Realizar interpretações de tratados bilaterais, identificação de alternativas para minimizar o efeito da carga tributária;
  • Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos de trabalho produtivos com os funcionários de clientes e avaliar sua satisfação.
  • Contribuir com ideias/opiniões para as equipes de impostos e ouvir/ser receptivo ao ponto de vista de outros membros da equipe.

Por que você?

Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua: 


• Graduação em direito, administração ou contabilidade;


• Inglês avançado/fluente;


• Experiência em tributação de lucros auferidos em diferentes países e sobre remessas para o exterior;


• Habilidades avançadas de comunicação verbal e escrita;


• Dedicação ao trabalho em equipe e à liderança. 

Poderá ser um diferencial, caso você tenha os seguintes requisitos: 

  • Experiência em reorganizações societárias, tais quais reestruturações, fusões, aquisições e transações similares;
  • Familiaridade com tributos diretos em operações internacionais;
  • Expertise em elaboração de propostas técnicas e desenvolvimento de novos negócios;
  • Conhecimento em Digital TAX.

O que oferecemos: Vale Alimentação, Vale Refeição, Vale Transporte, Plano de saúde, Assistência odontológica, Universidade Corporativa e outros benefícios Educacionais, Gympass, PLR, e muito mais. Acesse  e conheça nosso universo de benefícios. 

Quem somos 

Somos uma das maiores empresas de serviços do mundo, em Auditoria, Consultoria, Impostos, Estratégia e Transações, orientados à Tecnologia. Com presença em mais de 150 países, aqui você terá a oportunidade de viver as experiências excepcionais que só a EY pode oferecer, com alcance global, cultura inclusiva e tecnologia para se tornar a sua melhor versão. 

Aqui, acreditamos que a força que impulsiona a inovação vem da diversidade de pessoas e ideias, por isso nossas vagas são destinadas para todas as pessoas. Oferecemos o suporte necessário, provendo acessibilidade para pessoas com deficiência, aplicação de metodologia de trabalho assistido para pessoas com deficiência intelectual e neurodiversas, assim como incentivamos a divulgação de vagas afirmativas como o Programa de Trainees exclusivo para PcD. A EY também conta com o grupo de afinidade Abilities+ que promove ações internas para a construção de um ambiente mais inclusivo.

Segundo o Great Place to Work  2023, somos a melhor empresa para pessoas LGBTQ+ do Brasil e a 2a melhor empresa para Mulheres e para Pessoas Pretas. Além disso, você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade.

Quer se sentir desafiado/a, motivado/a e valorizado/a todos os dias? Inspirar mudanças e deixar um legado? Faça parte do nosso time e ajude-nos na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor

title: diretor de captação de recursos
description:
DIRETOR(A) DE CAPTAÇÃO DE RECURSOS (FULL-TIME)

Sobre a Alves Foundation:

A Alves Foundation é uma organização 501(c)(3) sem fins lucrativos com sede nos Estados Unidos, dedicada a projetos de impacto social e reconstrução em comunidades vulneráveis. Estamos liderando o Projeto Reconstrói Paraná, a maior operação de reconstrução solidária da história do Brasil, com a meta de arrecadar R$ 57 milhões em 7 meses para reconstruir 380 casas destruídas pelo tornado de novembro de 2025.

Sua Missão:

Como Diretor(a) de Captação de Recursos, você liderará toda a estratégia de arrecadação de R$ 57 milhões para o Projeto Reconstrói Paraná. Você será o(a) maestro(a) da orquestra, coordenando uma equipe de 9 profissionais estratégicos e garantindo que todas as frentes de captação (parcerias corporativas, grandes doadores, crowdfunding e eventos) trabalhem em perfeita sinergia para bater a meta histórica.

Responsabilidades:

Você gerenciará e mentorará a equipe estratégica, definindo e acompanhando metas mensais que variam de R$ 3 milhões a R$ 12 milhões. Conduzirá pessoalmente as negociações mais estratégicas com parceiros TIER 1, pilotando a campanha usando dashboards em tempo real e tomando decisões rápidas baseadas em dados. Será o porta-voz da captação para a mídia nacional e internacional, participando de eventos de alto impacto e representando a Alves Foundation em reuniões com empresas, fundações e grandes doadores.

Requisitos:

Buscamos um líder com mais de 10 anos de experiência em captação de recursos, vendas complexas ou desenvolvimento de negócios, preferencialmente com experiência em organizações sem fins lucrativos. É essencial ter experiência comprovada em liderança de equipes de alta performance e habilidade de negociação com C-levels, fundações internacionais e HNWIs. Você deve ter visão estratégica e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos canais simultaneamente, além de paixão por causas sociais e resiliência para trabalhar sob pressão em um projeto de 7 meses com metas agressivas.

O que Oferecemos:

Remuneração: R$ 4.000/mês (PJ)

Alimentação e hospedagem durante viagens ao Paraná

Exposição massiva em todas as plataformas do projeto (mídia nacional e internacional)

Certificado oficial da Alves Foundation

Networking com grandes empresas, fundações internacionais e executivos C-level

Oportunidade de liderar um projeto de legado que vai impactar 380 famílias e capacitar 140 profissionais
